name: 兩欄寬幅圖片帶並排＋內縮文字
desc: 兩個大項目左右並排，橫式圖片接成一條幾乎橫跨畫面的寬幅帶；圖片下方是較內縮的標題、說明文字與按鈕。
prompt: 建立一個高度依內容而定的區塊。區塊上方留大片空白，約三分之一個畫面高，下方不留白。沒有獨立的標題組；內容是多個項目排成的網格，每列兩個大項目，左右等寬。每個項目上方是一張橫式圖片，兩張圖片同一比例、項目之間沒有間距，接成一條幾乎橫跨整個畫面寬的寬幅圖片帶，左右只留少許邊，比下方文字的範圍更寬。圖片下方是靠左的文字，比圖片內縮更多：標題，前方可放一個小圖示；下方是說明文字（可多行）；最下方是一個圖示按鈕，旁邊接一個文字連結，緊接在說明文字下方，所以兩欄的按鈕不一定在同一高度。小圖示、說明文字、按鈕與文字連結沒有時省略，其他元素的位置不變。
mobile: 改為直向堆疊，每列一個項目，依序為第一個項目的圖片、文字，再接第二個項目的圖片、文字；兩張圖片不再相連，寬度對齊頁面內容寬度。區塊上方的大片空白縮小，下方仍不留白。

en.name: Two-column wide image band with inset text
en.desc: Two large items side by side; their landscape images join into a wide band that nearly spans the viewport; below each image is a more inset title, description and button.
en.prompt: Create a section whose height is determined by its content. Leave a large empty space at the top of the section, about a third of a viewport tall, and no spacing at the bottom. There is no separate heading group; the content is a grid of multiple items with two large items per row, of equal width. Each item has a landscape image at the top; both images share the same proportion and there is no gap between the items, so they join into a wide image band that nearly spans the full viewport width, with only a small margin on the left and right, wider than the text below. Below the image is left-aligned text, inset further than the image: a title, optionally with a small icon in front of it; below it a description (may wrap to multiple lines); and at the bottom an icon button with a text link beside it, placed directly below the description, so the buttons in the two columns are not necessarily at the same height. Omit the small icon, description, button and text link when there is no content, without changing the position of the other elements.
en.mobile: Stacks vertically with one item per row, in the order: first item's image, its text, then the second item's image and its text; the two images are no longer joined and align to the page content width. The large empty space at the top of the section becomes smaller, and the bottom still has no spacing.
